thread:
Asha (CS): Aurora week0 private deploy check-in. Quick note: network + IAM mostly good but two onboarding snags: 1) audit lines arriving at their SIEM are truncated (missing requestParameters), looks like a collector/MTU issue; 2) KMS operations failing with AccessDenied for our cross-account deploy role (policy missing kms:GenerateDataKey). Tagging @Marta @Noah to triage. :wave:

Marta (Platform): On it. Can you paste one of the redacted truncated lines and the KMS error text?

Asha (CS): Sample (redacted):
{ eventTime: "2026-08-10T12:00:00Z", eventName: "StartInstances", userIdentity: { type: "AssumedRole", arn: "arn:aws:sts::666666666666:assumed-role/AuroraCross/DeployRole" }, requestParameters: "{\"InstanceIds\":[\"i-0abc...\"]}" }  // note: original payload exceeded 1500B and collector shows "<truncated>" at end

KMS error from deploy job: "AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::666666666666:assumed-role/AuroraCross/DeployRole is not authorized to perform: kms:GenerateDataKey on resource arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:777777777777:key/abcd-ef01"

Noah (Security): Truncation smells like a UDP syslog forwarder or an S3-to-SIEM ingestion buffer. If they're using UDP or a flaky forwarder, nested JSON can be split. Recommend switching to HTTPS/TLS delivery or increasing max_payload and enabling message batching on the forwarder. I'll draft exact Fluentd/Syslog config snippets.

Marta (Platform): I pulled the health artifact: HealthBot shows network:ok iam:ok kms:policy:fail audit:truncated. Link: https://artifacts.redwood/aurora/week0/8023456789. I'll prepare a minimal key-policy PR granting kms:GenerateDataKey, kms:Decrypt to the cross-account principal and post a snippet for their infra to approve. Patch ETA: 24h.

Asha (CS): Plan: 1) Marta -> key-policy PR + policy snippet to customer for approval; 2) Noah -> forwarder/runbook changes (require TCP/TLS, buffer > 8k, preserve full payload) and example Fluentd config; 3) If unresolved by Fri EOD mark renewal risk as low-medium and schedule remediation call.

Marta (Platform): Agree. I'll also add a preflight that validates KMS permissions during our smoke-run to catch this earlier.

Noah (Security): I'll include exact audit test (send a 6KB synthetic CloudTrail event through their collector) so they can verify end-to-end. Delivery by tomorrow noon.

Asha (CS): Scheduling 20m sync tomorrow 09:00 PT. I'll DM Aurora ops a short summary and request temporary read-only access to their collector logs if needed. Tagging thread "week0-health" and adding to renewal-watch until cleared. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
